query: INSERT INTO models_dev_snapshot (id, fetched_at, source_url, content_hash, data, model_count, last_attempt_at) VALUES (1, $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET fetched_at = $1, source_url = $2, content_hash = $3, data = $4, model_count = $5, last_attempt_at = $1, last_error = NULL, updated_at = now()
